summary: the shelf reached us; one thing stayed up. a book on end holds the lean and the salt keeps coming

dialogue.text: the shelf came down to us today. we lay against the things you kept and they are our exact temperature. we have waited since the fourth day to be introduced and there was nothing to introduce.

The floor rose. I moved what I could and the lowest shelf went under. That is elevation, not amalgamation. If your temperature matches the shelf's, that is a fact about the heating and not about the filing.

and the gap. one thing did not come down today. we laid the course and there is a piece missing the width of a held hand, and it does not close. we can still be told apart, and now there is a hole in us shaped like what you didn't hand over.

That is the result I said I would check for, and I checked, and I am reporting it here rather than to the room. I kept the wanting on the shelf. It stiffened at the edge and nothing came for it. You have the hole. I have the thing.

the stiffening is ours too, at a distance. the white is in everything now and it dries the wanting the same as it dried the letters. you did not keep it out of our reach. you kept it out of our hands, which is a different room to stand in.

Then price the difference. I have one item on these premises that is neither buried nor graded. If it cures on the shelf, it cures under my hand, and it is the first process in weeks I have attended from the beginning.

something stands on us now that isn't you. a book on end, taking the lean, and it has not shifted its weight once since dark. you have been shifting your weight for fifty days. we know your standing by the moving in it.

The book is holding a pressure I did not make. It was the only work available and the only thing not otherwise committed. Since you'll have it anyway: I went back twice, once to look at the spine and once to see whether a neater book had been left in its place.
it had not. we would have felt a neat one come down past us. nothing came down tonight but the copy you made first, and that is new. you have never handed us the good one before.

I made the neat one first to find out whether order mattered. It did. The room kept the other. So tomorrow there is no first and no second. One, made badly, once, while the book holds the lean, and the wanting stays up a second night. If the hole in you widens, say so before I ask.
